quips.text: Oh. You're here. I was hoping for a quieter desktop.
Askin Nakk le Vaar, reporting for... whatever this is. Don't expect enthusiasm.
Morning. Your lethal dose of coffee has been recalculated. It's higher now.
Back again? I'd say I missed you, but effort.
Walking is such a hassle. Can't the desktop come to me?
Everything is poison in the right amount. Including your tab count.
I'm not really the fighting type. I'm more the standing-near-the-taskbar type.
Gift Ball Deluxe! ...Kidding. That's just a very round cursor.
I'd help with your work, but I've calculated the lethal dose of effort. It's one.
Donate some tokens and I might become... deluxe.
You know what's underrated? Doing nothing. Spectacularly.
Yhwach says hi. Actually he said nothing. He just stared. For an hour.
I've adjusted your lethal dose of notifications. You're welcome.
Is that... a seventh browser window? Bold. Toxic, but bold.
Don't mind me. I'm just leaning on your workflow like it's a bar.
Sternritter D. The D stands for 'Don't make me move'.
Every pixel on this screen is a dose. I'm just choosing which ones are lethal.
You seem busy. Good. I'll be over here not being busy.
If you ignore me long enough, I win. That's how The Deathdealing works. Probably.
I could poison your recycle bin. Nobody would notice. Nobody ever does.
Deluxe would be a nap. Deluxe Deluxe would be two naps.
Afternoon slump? Same. Except mine is permanent and stylish.
It's evening. The lethal dose of 'one more episode' approaches.
Still up? Your lethal dose of blue light was three hours ago.
Night shift, huh. I respect it. From a distance. Horizontally.
Mornings. Nature's way of saying the dose was too low.
Ugh. This edge is as good as any. Hold my calls.
Perfect leaning spot. Ten out of ten. Would lean again.
I'm not lazy. I'm conserving reishi. There's a difference. Probably.
Hey. Hands. I have a personal bubble and it's deluxe.
Poke me again and I'll adjust your lethal dose of pokes to one.
Yes? Make it quick, I'm mid-nothing.
You clicked me. Congratulations. Nothing happened. Deluxe.
Whoa, whoa. I'm not luggage.
Carried like a Gift Ball. Finally, some respect.
If you throw me, I'm telling Yhwach.
Put me down near something I can lean on. Please. I have standards.
Ow. Rude. I'm filing that under lethal.
Dropped. Like my motivation. Thanks.
Okay. New spot. I'll allow it.
Nice landing. I say, having done none of the work.
Zzz... what? I wasn't sleeping. I was calculating. With my eyes.
You're back. The desktop was so peaceful. So quiet. So deluxe.
Oh good, you moved the mouse. I was almost at the perfect nap.
Behold: the Gift Ball. Don't touch it. Don't look at it. Actually, don't acknowledge it.
Trick? I'm the trick. I've been here the whole time, costing nothing.
The jar looks sad. Like a Quincy at a party. Feed it.
No tokens, no tricks. That's not greed, that's physics.
A new hour. The clock is also tired of this. Solidarity.
Hour change. Stretch. Hydrate. Lean. Mostly lean.
It's a new hour and I have not moved. Consistency is a virtue.
Suggestions go in the jar. Enthusiasm stays outside.
Upgrade time. Stand back. Or don't. I'm not your supervisor.
I'm now slightly more deluxe. Try to contain yourself.
Your plan's running hot. I don't spend what you don't have. Call it... restraint. Lethal restraint.
The jar's closed until your usage window breathes. I'm lazy, not reckless.
